## Problem

What is wrong or missing today.

## Change

What this pull request does about it.

## Testing

Commands run and their results. A bug fix names the regression test and says it
failed before the fix. Keep meeting content and real names out of the
description and the tests.

## Label

Add one label. It decides where this pull request lands in the release notes.

- [ ] `breaking` changes behaviour or storage in a way an existing install notices
- [ ] `feature` adds a capability a user can see
- [ ] `fix` corrects a defect in shipped behaviour
- [ ] `docs` changes documentation only
- [ ] `ci` changes workflows, scripts, or the build itself
- [ ] `chore` is maintenance work with no user-visible effect
- [ ] `dependencies` updates a dependency
- [ ] `skip-changelog` keeps this pull request out of the notes
